The decisive mistake was at step 1. The Biblical Scholar's quoted passage skipped over "India" in Esther 1:1, which reads "from India to Cush." India is the first place named in the book, ahead of Susa. Starting from the wrong place sent the whole chain off course. In April 1977 India's Prime Minister was Morarji Desai, but the team answered Hoveyda of Iran.
